issues.reason: "lost" here is intransitive and George Allen is neither a change-of-state undergoer (the collapse / melt / expire / lapse family) nor a natural force nor a stative holder, so the intransitive-subject test lands on its stated default "When unclear, Agent", making (Patient sk_lose_1 george_allen) a rule violation.

"to Democrat Robb" answers no whither question, and the oblique routing rule says the named roles apply only when the PP answers where / when / how / whence / whither and to "decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest", so the preposition-named (To sk_lose_1 robb) is the licensed head, not the spatial Goal.

gaps_confirmed: capitalized role / party noun immediately before a proper name ("Incumbent George Allen", "Democrat Robb"): the mechanical casing cue would fold it into the name run (democrat_robb), the title rule keeps it only in the Name string, and the appositive rule wants a separate typing atom — nothing adjudicates, and sentence-initial capitalization is not distinguished

Ordinal on a noun with no associated event and no "-est" dimension ("a third term"): the scale slot is specified only as the associated event or an explicit -est dimension, so the entity's own kind (term) as scale is unlicensed
new_gaps: the intransitive-subject role test has no branch for competitive / outcome verbs ("lose", "win", "fail"), whose subject is non-volitional yet undergoes no change of state — such verbs fall through to the "when unclear, Agent" default rather than being classified

the preposition-named oblique head To collides with the purpose-infinitive connective head To — (To <event> <entity>) vs (To <event> <event>) are the same head at the same arity, distinguished only by argument type
repair_summary: Changed (Patient sk_lose_1 george_allen) to (Agent sk_lose_1 george_allen) per the intransitive-subject default; changed (Goal sk_lose_1 robb) to the preposition-named oblique (To sk_lose_1 robb); renamed the two affected proof names (e_lose_pat -> e_lose_ag, e_lose_goal -> e_lose_to) so they stay descriptive, everything else byte-identical.
notes: The two appositive typings correctly take the past host clause's wrapper and (But sk_run_1 sk_lose_1) keeps main-clause-first surface order; the ground/prize (For sk_run_1 sk_term_1) is right against the Beneficiary split. Both gap-territory improvisations (democrat typing, term as Ordinal scale) emit only true, well-typed atoms and so stand.
